email_body:
Dear EVTA team,

I'm writing to apply for the EU Communications Assistant (CIP Internship) in Brussels. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I work where SEO, content and web meet: I build and optimize websites, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate repetitive work. I'm fluent in English and based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, so I can join in late November.

What draws me to EVTA is the chance to apply my design and content skills in a European project context. I have hands-on experience with WordPress, Canva, and creating visuals for social media and websites. I've also built sites with structured data and accessible markup, and I'm comfortable using AI tools responsibly. I'm curious, proactive, and eager to learn about EU affairs and vocational training.

I've attached my CV and portfolio for your review. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear EVTA team,

I'm excited to apply for the EU Communications Assistant (CIP Internship) in Brussels. As a digital marketer with a technical background, I work where SEO, content and web meet: I build and optimize websites, write content that ranks, and use AI tools and code to automate repetitive work. I'm fluent in English and based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, so I can join in late November.

What draws me to EVTA is the opportunity to apply my design and content skills in a European project context. In my freelance work, I designed and built baverok.com in WordPress/Elementor, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and accessible markup. For mirook.com, I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and manage CMS content in WordPress. I've also used Canva for visuals and am comfortable with AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for research and content creation.

I'm particularly interested in EVTA's work across digital innovation, inclusion, sustainability, and skills development. I'm curious, proactive, and open-minded, and I'm eager to learn about EU institutions, NGOs, and Erasmus+ projects. While I haven't worked directly in EU affairs, my experience with international clients and remote collaboration has prepared me to adapt quickly and contribute to a multilingual team.

I'm confident that my mix of design, content, and technical skills can support EVTA's communications goals. I'm eager to bring my creativity and technical mindset to your team and to grow through this apprenticeship.

Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my CV and portfolio, and I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to EVTA.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
